name: TallyPrime
description: TallyPrime accounting (Tally Solutions) over its XML/HTTP interface: companies, ledgers, groups, stock items, Trial Balance, Balance Sheet, Profit and Loss, Day Book, ledger statements and outstanding receivables and payables. Read-only.
instructions:
## TallyPrime
This connector reads a TallyPrime installation (Tally Solutions) through its built-in XML over HTTP interface: companies, ledgers, groups, voucher types, stock items, Trial Balance, Balance Sheet, Profit and Loss, Day Book, ledger statements and outstanding receivables and payables. Version 1 is read-only: no voucher or master is created or changed.

## Setup
1. In TallyPrime press **F1 (Help) > Settings > Connectivity > Client/Server configuration**. Set **TallyPrime acts as** to **Server** (or **Both**), enable ODBC, keep the port (default **9000**) and accept. Restart TallyPrime if asked.
2. Open (load) the companies you want to read. The HTTP interface only sees companies that are open in the running TallyPrime.
3. Put the address in `TALLY_URL`, e.g. `http://192.168.1.20:9000`. Opening that address in a browser on the same network shows a short "TallyPrime Server is Running" text.

## Network
TallyPrime runs on the customer's own computer or server, so AnythingMCP must be able to reach it. AnythingMCP Cloud cannot reach a LAN address (192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x): run a self-hosted AnythingMCP on the same network and add the host to `SSRF_ALLOWED_HOSTS`, or publish the port through a secure tunnel or VPN. The Tally port has **no password**: anyone who can reach it can read and import data, so never open it to the internet without access control in front of it.

## How the tools work
Every tool POSTs an XML request (`TALLYREQUEST` Export) to the root of the server. Masters come from TDL collections (clean objects: `LEDGER`, `STOCKITEM`, `GROUP` with their fields); reports come back in Tally's display format, where each row is a pair of tags, e.g. `DSPACCNAME/DSPDISPNAME` (name) followed by `DSPACCINFO` with `DSPCLDRAMTA` (closing debit, negative) and `DSPCLCRAMTA` (closing credit). After parsing, these are parallel lists: the n-th name belongs to the n-th amount row. Amounts use Tally's sign convention: debit negative, credit positive.

## Values
- **Company**: every tool except `tallyprime_list_companies` needs the exact company name. Start with `tallyprime_list_companies`.
- **Dates** are YYYYMMDD (`20250401`). Indian financial years run 1 April to 31 March; outside the company's books Tally returns an empty report.
- **Names** of ledgers, groups and voucher types must match exactly. Names are placed inside XML, so write `&` as `&` (for example `Sharma & Sons`).
- An error such as "Could not set SVCurrentCompany" means the company is not open in TallyPrime or the name differs.

## Where to start
`tallyprime_list_companies`, then `tallyprime_get_trial_balance` for an overview, `tallyprime_get_bills_receivable` for who owes money, `tallyprime_get_ledger_vouchers` for one party's statement, and `tallyprime_get_day_book` for the vouchers of a short period. Large reports over a long period can take several seconds and return a lot of data: keep ranges to a month where possible.
prerequisites: TallyPrime must be running with its server switched on (**F1 > Settings > Connectivity**, port 9000) and be reachable from AnythingMCP: use a self-hosted AnythingMCP on the same network, or a secure tunnel or VPN. AnythingMCP Cloud cannot reach a LAN address such as 192.168.x.x, and the Tally port has no password, so never expose it to the internet without access control.

TALLY_URL.label: TallyPrime server address
TALLY_URL.help: Address and port of the computer running TallyPrime, as reachable from AnythingMCP. The port is set in TallyPrime under F1 > Settings > Connectivity > Client/Server configuration (default 9000).
TALLY_URL.patternMessage: Only the address and port, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:9000, with nothing after it.

verifyHints.unreachable: TallyPrime could not be reached at this address. Check that TallyPrime is running, that F1 > Settings > Connectivity has it acting as Server on this port, and that the address is reachable from AnythingMCP: AnythingMCP Cloud cannot reach a LAN address.
verifyHints.bad_request: TallyPrime rejected the request. Check that at least one company is open in TallyPrime.

tools.name: tallyprime_list_companies
tools.description: List the companies currently open (loaded) in TallyPrime with their name, financial year start and books-beginning date. Call this first: every other tool needs the exact company name.

tools.name: tallyprime_list_ledgers
tools.description: List every ledger (accounting head: customers, suppliers, banks, expenses, taxes) of a company with its parent group, opening and closing balance, phone and e-mail. Use it to find exact ledger names.

company.description: Exact name of a company that is open in TallyPrime, as returned by tallyprime_list_companies. Write & as & and < as < because the value is placed inside XML.

tools.name: tallyprime_list_ledgers_in_group
tools.description: List the ledgers under one group, including its sub-groups, with parent, opening and closing balance. Use Sundry Debtors for customers, Sundry Creditors for suppliers, Bank Accounts for banks.

company.description: Exact name of a company that is open in TallyPrime, as returned by tallyprime_list_companies. Write & as & and < as < because the value is placed inside XML.

group.description: Exact group name, e.g. Sundry Debtors, Sundry Creditors, Bank Accounts, or a group from tallyprime_list_groups. Write & as & and < as < because the value is placed inside XML.

bodyMapping.__raw: <ENVELOPE><HEADER><VERSION>1</VERSION><TALLYREQUEST>Export</TALLYREQUEST><TYPE>Collection</TYPE><ID>List of Ledgers</ID></HEADER><BODY><DESC><STATICVARIABLES><SVEXPORTFORMAT>$$SysName:XML</SVEXPORTFORMAT><SVCURRENTCOMPANY>${company}</SVCURRENTCOMPANY></STATICVARIABLES><TDL><TDLMESSAGE><COLLECTION NAME="List of Ledgers" ISMODIFY="Yes"><ADD>CHILD OF : ${group}</ADD><ADD>BELONGS TO : Yes</ADD><NATIVEMETHOD>Name</NATIVEMETHOD><NATIVEMETHOD>Parent</NATIVEMETHOD><NATIVEMETHOD>OpeningBalance</NATIVEMETHOD><NATIVEMETHOD>ClosingBalance</NATIVEMETHOD></COLLECTION></TDLMESSAGE></TDL></DESC></BODY></ENVELOPE>

tools.name: tallyprime_get_ledger
tools.description: Get one ledger master: parent group, opening and closing balance, mailing name, address, state, PIN code, country, phone, mobile and e-mail. Use it for a customer's or supplier's contact and balance.

company.description: Exact name of a company that is open in TallyPrime, as returned by tallyprime_list_companies. Write & as & and < as < because the value is placed inside XML.

ledger.description: Exact ledger name as shown in TallyPrime, e.g. a customer or supplier ledger from tallyprime_list_ledgers. Write & as & and < as < because the value is placed inside XML.

tools.name: tallyprime_list_groups
tools.description: List the account groups of a company (the chart of accounts) with each group's parent. Primary groups such as Current Assets or Sundry Debtors have the company itself as parent.

company.description: Exact name of a company that is open in TallyPrime, as returned by tallyprime_list_companies. Write & as & and < as < because the value is placed inside XML.

tools.name: tallyprime_list_voucher_types
tools.description: List the voucher types of a company (Sales, Purchase, Receipt, Payment, Journal, Contra, Credit Note, Debit Note and any custom ones) with the type each is based on. Use it before tallyprime_get_day_book_by_type.

company.description: Exact name of a company that is open in TallyPrime, as returned by tallyprime_list_companies. Write & as & and < as < because the value is placed inside XML.

tools.name: tallyprime_list_stock_items
tools.description: List the stock items of a company with stock group, base unit, opening quantity and value, and closing quantity and value for the current period. Use it for inventory questions.

company.description: Exact name of a company that is open in TallyPrime, as returned by tallyprime_list_companies. Write & as & and < as < because the value is placed inside XML.

tools.name: tallyprime_get_trial_balance
tools.description: Get the Trial Balance for a period, exploded down to ledgers: closing debit and credit balance per group and ledger. Use it for an overview of all balances.

company.description: Exact name of a company that is open in TallyPrime, as returned by tallyprime_list_companies. Write & as & and < as < because the value is placed inside XML.

from_date.description: Start of the period, YYYYMMDD, e.g. 20250401 for the start of the 2025-26 financial year.

to_date.description: End of the period, YYYYMMDD, e.g. 20260331. Must lie within the company's books.

tools.name: tallyprime_get_balance_sheet
tools.description: Get the Balance Sheet as at the end of a period: liabilities and assets by primary group with their closing amounts.

company.description: Exact name of a company that is open in TallyPrime, as returned by tallyprime_list_companies. Write & as & and < as < because the value is placed inside XML.

from_date.description: Start of the period, YYYYMMDD, e.g. 20250401 for the start of the 2025-26 financial year.

to_date.description: End of the period, YYYYMMDD, e.g. 20260331. Must lie within the company's books.

tools.name: tallyprime_get_profit_and_loss
tools.description: Get the Profit and Loss account for a period: income and expenses by group (sales, purchases, direct and indirect expenses and incomes) and the net result.

company.description: Exact name of a company that is open in TallyPrime, as returned by tallyprime_list_companies. Write & as & and < as < because the value is placed inside XML.

from_date.description: Start of the period, YYYYMMDD, e.g. 20250401 for the start of the 2025-26 financial year.

to_date.description: End of the period, YYYYMMDD, e.g. 20260331. Must lie within the company's books.

tools.name: tallyprime_get_day_book
tools.description: Get the Day Book: every voucher entered in a period with date, voucher type, number, party, narration, ledger entries and amounts, and inventory lines. This is how to list vouchers by date range; keep the range short, a busy company has thousands of vouchers a month.

company.description: Exact name of a company that is open in TallyPrime, as returned by tallyprime_list_companies. Write & as & and < as < because the value is placed inside XML.

from_date.description: Start of the period, YYYYMMDD, e.g. 20250401 for the start of the 2025-26 financial year.

to_date.description: End of the period, YYYYMMDD, e.g. 20260331. Must lie within the company's books.

tools.name: tallyprime_get_day_book_by_type
tools.description: Get the vouchers of one voucher type in a period (for example only Sales or only Receipt vouchers) with full ledger entries and amounts. Voucher type names come from tallyprime_list_voucher_types.

company.description: Exact name of a company that is open in TallyPrime, as returned by tallyprime_list_companies. Write & as & and < as < because the value is placed inside XML.

from_date.description: Start of the period, YYYYMMDD, e.g. 20250401 for the start of the 2025-26 financial year.

to_date.description: End of the period, YYYYMMDD, e.g. 20260331. Must lie within the company's books.

voucher_type.description: Exact voucher type name, e.g. Sales, Purchase, Receipt, Payment, Journal, Credit Note. Write & as & and < as < because the value is placed inside XML.

bodyMapping.__raw: <ENVELOPE><HEADER><VERSION>1</VERSION><TALLYREQUEST>Export</TALLYREQUEST><TYPE>Data</TYPE><ID>Day Book</ID></HEADER><BODY><DESC><STATICVARIABLES><SVEXPORTFORMAT>$$SysName:XML</SVEXPORTFORMAT><SVCURRENTCOMPANY>${company}</SVCURRENTCOMPANY><SVFROMDATE TYPE="Date">${from_date}</SVFROMDATE><SVTODATE TYPE="Date">${to_date}</SVTODATE></STATICVARIABLES><TDL><TDLMESSAGE><REPORT NAME="Day Book" ISMODIFY="Yes" ISFIXED="No" ISINITIALIZE="No" ISOPTION="No" ISINTERNAL="No"><LOCAL>Collection : Default : Add : Filter : AMCPVchTypeFilter</LOCAL><LOCAL>Collection : Default : Add : Fetch : VoucherTypeName</LOCAL></REPORT><SYSTEM TYPE="Formulae" NAME="AMCPVchTypeFilter" ISMODIFY="No" ISFIXED="No" ISINTERNAL="No">$VoucherTypeName = "${voucher_type}"</SYSTEM></TDLMESSAGE></TDL></DESC></BODY></ENVELOPE>

tools.name: tallyprime_get_ledger_vouchers
tools.description: Get the ledger account (statement) of one ledger for a period: opening balance, every voucher posted to it with date, type, number, counter ledger and debit or credit amount, and the closing balance.

to_date.description: End of the period, YYYYMMDD, e.g. 20260331. Must lie within the company's books.

ledger.description: Exact ledger name as shown in TallyPrime, e.g. a customer or supplier ledger from tallyprime_list_ledgers. Write & as & and < as < because the value is placed inside XML.

tools.description: Get outstanding receivables: every open sales bill with bill date, reference, party, pending amount, due date and days overdue. Needs bill-wise details enabled on the customer ledgers.

tools.description: Get outstanding payables: every open purchase bill with bill date, reference, party, pending amount, due date and days overdue. Needs bill-wise details enabled on the supplier ledgers.
